theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addableAlong_append_singleton (is l : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
AddableAlong l (is ++ [j]) ↔ AddableAlong l is ∧ IsAddable (addCellSteps l is) j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCellSteps_append_singleton (is l : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
addCellSteps l (is ++ [j]) = addCell (addCellSteps l is) j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_addCellSteps_nil {is : List ℕ} (haa : AddableAlong [] is) (i : ℕ) :
(addCellSteps [] is).getD i 0 = List.count i is

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.lt_length_addCellSteps {is l : List ℕ} (haa : AddableAlong l is) {i : ℕ} (h : 0 < l.getD i 0 + List.count i is) :
i < (addCellSteps l is).length

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_addCellSteps (is l : List ℕ) :
AddableAlong l is → ∀ (i : ℕ), (addCellSteps l is).getD i 0 = l.getD i 0 + List.count i is

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.lt_length_of_getD_pos {l : List ℕ} {i : ℕ} (h : 0 < l.getD i 0) :
i < l.length

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCellSteps_insertWord (w : List ℕ) :
addCellSteps [] (rowIndices [] w) = tableauShape (insertWord w)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addableAlong_insertWord (w : List ℕ) :
AddableAlong [] (rowIndices [] w)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addableAlong_rowIndices (w : List ℕ) (T : List (List ℕ)) :
ColStrict T → AddableAlong (tableauShape T) (rowIndices T w) ∧ addCellSteps (tableauShape T) (rowIndices T w) = tableauShape (List.foldl insert T w)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.isAddable_newRowIndex {T : List (List ℕ)} (hc : ColStrict T) (x : ℕ) :
IsAddable (tableauShape T) (newRowIndex T x)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.newRowIndex_le (T : List (List ℕ)) (x : ℕ) :
newRowIndex T x ≤ (tableauShape T).length

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.tableauShape_insert (T : List (List ℕ)) (x : ℕ) :
tableauShape (insert T x) = addCell (tableauShape T) (newRowIndex T x)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCell_cons_succ (a : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) (j : ℕ) :
addCell (a :: l) (j + 1) = a :: addCell l j

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.shapeCornersAlong_and_empty {is : List ℕ} (haa : AddableAlong [] is) :
ShapeCornersAlong (addCellSteps [] is) is ∧ removeCornerSteps (addCellSteps [] is) is = []

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.youngShape_nil :
YoungShape []

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.shapeCornersAlong_of_addable {l is : List ℕ} (hy : YoungShape l) (haa : AddableAlong l is) :
ShapeCornersAlong (addCellSteps l is) is

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.shapeCornersAlong_addCellSteps (is l : List ℕ) :
YoungShape l → AddableAlong l is → ShapeCornersAlong (addCellSteps l is) is ∧ removeCornerSteps (addCellSteps l is) is = l

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addableAlong_cons (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ) :
AddableAlong l (i :: rest) ↔ IsAddable l i ∧ AddableAlong (addCell l i) rest

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addableAlong_nil (l : List ℕ) :
AddableAlong l []

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.AddableAlong :
List ℕ → List ℕ → Prop

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCellSteps_cons (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ) :
addCellSteps l (i :: rest) = addCellSteps (addCell l i) rest

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCellSteps_nil (l : List ℕ) :
addCellSteps l [] = l

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCellSteps :
List ℕ → List ℕ → List ℕ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.removeCorner_addCell {l : List ℕ} (hy : YoungShape l) {i : ℕ} (ha : IsAddable l i) :
SYTEnum.removeCorner (addCell l i) i = l

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.isCorner_addCell {l : List ℕ} (hy : YoungShape l) {i : ℕ} (ha : IsAddable l i) :
SYTEnum.IsCorner (addCell l i) i

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.youngShape_addCell {l : List ℕ} (hy : YoungShape l) {i : ℕ} (ha : IsAddable l i) :
YoungShape (addCell l i)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.sorted_of_getD_step (l : List ℕ) :
(∀ (m : ℕ), l.getD (m + 1) 0 ≤ l.getD m 0) → List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_addCell_ne (l : List ℕ) {i j : ℕ} (hj : j ≤ l.length) (hij : i ≠ j) :
(addCell l j).getD i 0 = l.getD i 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_addCell_self (l : List ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ l.length) :
(addCell l i).getD i 0 = l.getD i 0 + 1

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.lt_length_addCell (l : List ℕ) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ≤ l.length) :
i < (addCell l i).length

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.IsAddable (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
Prop

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addCell (l : List ℕ) (i : ℕ) :
List ℕ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_succ_le_of_sorted (l : List ℕ) :
List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 ≥ x2) l → ∀ (i : ℕ), l.getD (i + 1) 0 ≤ l.getD i 0

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.YoungShape (l : List ℕ) :
Prop

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_past {l : List ℕ} {i : ℕ} (h : l.length ≤ i) :
l.getD i 0 = 0
